Measured 1.420 km/yr Balkans → Rhine on the dev solve arm against the band's 1.3 (Pinhasi, Fort & Ammerman 2005, 0.6–1.3), 1.077 before W12 §1. The corrected hop share is not a tuning: a hop of mean square ⟨d²⟩ delivers s·⟨d²⟩/4 of diffusivity, so the share that delivers D is 4·D·dt/⟨d²⟩ and not D·dt/area. The SAME constants measure 0.670 km/yr at the shipped grid — inside the band for the first time. Identical physics, two grids: the 167 km reference lattice moves a share of a whole cell's people 167 km in a single hop, so its pulled front outruns the continuum 2·√(r·D) the constants name, where the 42 km shipped lattice does not. The coarse lattice flattered the front before and flatters it the other way now. A dev-raster row measured against the grid that ships (third cardinal rule); recorded, not dialed.

Recorded as the open question it is, not dialed.
